## Why This Is Asked

## Code Example

```python
# Attestation verification sketch
import json
from crypto import verify_quote, load_public_key

def verify_enclave_quote(quote_b64, tenant_id, public_keys):
    quote = json.loads(quote_b64)
    pub = public_keys[tenant_id]
    if quote['tenant_id'] != tenant_id:
        return False
    return verify_quote(quote['report'], pub)
```

```python
import json
SENSITIVE = {\"token\",\"password\",\"apiKey\",\"secret\"}

def redact(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k:(\"[REDACTED]\" if k in SENSITIVE else redact(v)) for k,v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return [redact(i) for i in obj]
    return obj
```

